shared_elements: long horizontal line or band crossing the field
justification: Both surfaces depict an anthropomorphic figure together with round disc-like motifs and long horizontal lines, but these are near-universal elements rather than a shared specific motif; A's discs are shields ranged along a ship's hull and spiral hip-marks on a horse, while B's is a large concentric-ring disc fused to the figure's own body. A shows a narrative multi-register scene (mounted rider, sailing ship with crew, dense interlace frame) rendered with fine outline and internal detail, whereas B is a single flat schematic silhouette with plain limbs and no framing ornament.
